verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 112.9 (+0.2% in a day) and momentum is 40: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,500 and 86s 5,000. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-05T07:18:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Ellen White 88 Base Icon after its 19% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 405,000 coins. Now 390,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 6 so far, averaging -1.7% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Erëleta Memeti 84 Team of the week after its 13% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 14,500 coins. Now 12,750. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 13.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 4 of 7 so far, averaging +7.9% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,750 (1.54 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Antonio Palumbo and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Antonio Palumbo 75 Rare -70.4%; James Hill 78 Rare -54.4%; Yacine Adli 76 Rare -47.0%; Christian Günter 75 Rare -45.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
